An '''amulet of influence''' was a device that could be created by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|wielders]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the force]]. Whoever wore the amulet was forced to obey the commands of the amulet's maker. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], known publicly as [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku, created an amulet of influence, which he gave to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Lyonie]]. His control over Lyonie almost allowed Dooku to conquer [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="FDCR" />
